units.source_text: 河童国回来之后，有一段时间我无法忍受我们人类的皮肤的气味。

en.t: After I returned from the land of the kappa, for a while I could not bear the smell of human skin.

units.source_text: 和人类相比，河童的确十分注意清洁。

en.t: Compared with human beings, kappa really are extremely attentive to cleanliness.

units.source_text: 而且我和河童相处习惯了，总觉得我们人类的脑袋很奇怪。

en.t: And once I had grown used to living among kappa, I always felt that human heads were very strange.

units.source_text: 这件事你可能无法理解。

en.t: You may not be able to understand this.

units.source_text: 先不用说眼睛和嘴，鼻子这东西最让我发怵。

en.t: Leaving aside the eyes and mouth, the nose was the thing that frightened me most.

units.source_text: 当然，我想方设法不去见任何人，

en.t: Of course, I did everything I could to avoid seeing anyone,

units.source_text: 但我好像跟我们人类也慢慢相处习惯了，

en.t: but it seems I gradually grew used to being around humans as well,

units.source_text: 大概过了半年，我就什么地方都能去了。

en.t: and after about half a year, I was able to go anywhere.

units.source_text: 难堪的是，我说话的时候，

en.t: The embarrassing thing was that when I was speaking,

units.source_text: 偶尔一不小心就会生活出一句河童话。

en.t: now and then, if I was careless, a phrase of kappa language would slip out.
